scope: Conditional evidence from the saved M44 V3 action timeline only; do not treat archived frames as universal deadlines.

v3_success.popukar_handoff: Friston retreat and legal Popukar deploy at 1440; Popukar BLOCK enemy_1108_uterer#5 at 1440 and kill it at 1692.
v3_success.old_leak_elimination: This eliminates the M42-V3-condition frame-1661 leak but does not establish a complete interception baseline.

event_chain.fact: Friston retreats and releases enemy_1108_uterer#5; Popukar deploys and blocks that enemy.
enemy_1112_emppnt#0 artillery hits Beagle for 461 PHYSICAL at locked_position [3,4] (runtime [col,row]).
A second 461 PHYSICAL artillery hit kills Beagle and releases enemy_1107_uoffcr#7.

first_failure.interpretation: Beagle had 853 HP and the two 461 hits alone account for 922 damage; actual healing before 1663 was insufficient or absent for this duty. The chain must be repaired through continuous coverage, not assumed from proximity or later deployment.
first_failure.must_check: Earlier Beagle damage, Medic2/Ansel/Hibiscus coverage, artillery lock and projectile timing, replacement cost/tile/cooling, capacity, and whether the next blocker can reach before release.

protected_targets.roadblock_4: Retained/reached pressure until destroyed by char_208_melan at 4320; the late clearance did not prevent either civilian death.
protected_targets.requirement: Plan a jointly consistent exposure window: route control, roadblock clearance timing, treatment, and artillery mitigation must all be observable before each protected target's lethal window.

full_result.v2_lesson: DEPLOY@1500 was legal and successful, but Friston had died at 1457; command success did not establish the handoff duty.

prediction_correction.m44_v1_skill_3240: The archived event has details.legal=false. Under the corrected matcher its prediction is EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED; the raw record remains unchanged.
prediction_correction.verification_rule: Predict command plus observable duty: BLOCK, kill, protected-target exposure elimination, safe arrival, or continuous route control. Do not credit command emission alone.

constraints: Use only normal-mode 1-3 star operators and exclude mode-preparation reserves.
Target simulator WIN with zero leaks, both protected targets alive and safe, and positive remaining life; operator deaths are recorded separately.
Use successful retreat refund and cooldown only when actually observed; death gives no refund.
Keep interception continuity through artillery casualties and replacements, including occupied capacity and in-flight artillery consequences.
Do not require killing the artillery or preserving all 23 M42 Steward attacks; solve exposure/interception with the tactical structure GPT selects.
Do not assume the M42 V3 3686.68 output was a complete safe window.
